channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Scott Brooks | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Scott Brooks from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JJ Redick on Scott Brooks
item.description:
JJ Redick on Lakers assistant Scott Brooks:

“For weeks, I was hit up by 20-25 NBA people that I gotta hire Scott Brooks.”

JJ Redick on Scott Brooks, May 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Scott Brooks
item.description:
“We walked up in the practice gym afterwards and he [Scott Brooks] told Thabo [Sefolosha], we’re all huddled up at half court. Scott Brooks gave the ball to Thabo and he said, ‘Here Thabo, shoot the ball two times.’ Thabo took two shots.”

Kendrick Perkins on Scott Brooks, Nov 13, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Russell Westbrook, Scott Brooks, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Tommy Sheppard on Bradley Beal and Russell Westbrook endorsing Scott Brooks:

“I take that all into account... I am aware of how people feel, how I feel... this is show-business, not show-friends... I am all about doing the very best thing for the Washington Wizards.”

Tommy Sheppard on Russell Westbrook, Scott Brooks, Bradley Beal, Jun 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks
item.description:
Russell Westbrook on the future of coach Scott Brooks:

“If it was up to me, Scotty’s not going anywhere. It’s not even a question or a conversation to even be brought up. If the conversation is brought to me, I’ll definitely voice my opinion like I am now and see what happens.”

Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks, Jun 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks
item.description:
Fred Katz:Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks:

“Behind the scenes, Scottie is one hell of a coach…All of the outside noise, it really doesn’t matter because we know how important he is and I know how important he is to myself and to the team.”

Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks, May 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks
item.description:
“We're moving in the right direction as a team. If we play the game the right way, the wins will come. I think we've gotta give a lot of credit to Coach Brooks. He doesn't get enough credit,”

Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks, Feb 21, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: John Wall on Scott Brooks
item.description:
John Wall on if he’s spoken with Wizards head coach Scott Brooks:

“Guys have my number, I have those guys numbers. If they wanted to talk to or reach out to me, they had the opportunity to. It’s almost two months since that’s happened. It is what it is.”

John Wall on Scott Brooks, Jan 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @KellyIkoNBA.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Scott Brooks
item.description:
“‘We’re going to build around you. We’re going to get guys around like’ – if I go anywhere else, granted, it may be a good team, but I would be a piece. Who knows if my role would be the same? My role here is, I love what it is. I love [Scott] Brooks. I love what we have. I love our young guys. I think the fact that we actually have guys that are committed to getting better.”

Bradley Beal on Scott Brooks, Apr 9, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Sashi Brown on Scott Brooks
item.description:
When it comes to the Wizards in particular, the bottom-line is that general manager Tommy Sheppard makes the basketball decisions while Brown and his staff do whatever they can to help make those decisions better reasoned and informed.

“I provide Tommy and [head coach Scott Brooks] and [assistant GM] Brett Greenberg and the rest of that staff as much support as we can through a player development and engagement function. Also, team operation as well and then certainly on the research and strategy side. They really could operate on their own if they absolutely needed to. We're here to supplement and enhance,”

Sashi Brown on Scott Brooks, Feb 23, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on Tommy Sheppard, Scott Brooks
item.description:
“I am very happy with the work and preparation Tommy Sheppard, Coach [Scott] Brooks and our staff have done and I’m confident we’ll execute both the draft and free agency in an expert manner,”

Ted Leonsis on Tommy Sheppard, Scott Brooks, Jun 18, 2019. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Ted Leonsis on Scott Brooks
item.description:
Leonsis on if he'll decide Scott Brooks' status before hiring a new GM/prez:

“Right now, we have decided on Scott’s status. He’s the coach of the team, and Tommy (Sheppard) is doing what he was doing reporting to me.”

Ted Leonsis on Scott Brooks, Apr 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Scott Brooks
item.description:
“It's funny, because I think coach Scott Brooks (Thursday) with the Wizards was yelling at his guys that he can shoot,”

Kyle Lowry on Scott Brooks, Feb 3, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kobe Bryant, Scott Brooks
item.description:
“When coach Scott Brooks trusted me to guard Kobe Bryant in 2010 in that playoff series that was a big moment for me because he trusted me and I felt like I worked my way up to that,”

Kevin Durant on Kobe Bryant, Scott Brooks, Nov 10, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks
item.description:
Fred Katz:Westbrook on Scott Brooks:

“I'm happy to see Scottie doing well in general. He's an unbelievable guy.”

Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks, Feb 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Scott Brooks
item.description:
“Guys just have to start stepping up and playing. If they want to play, coach is going to play you and if you don’t, he’s going to sit you down so it’s just a matter of us just being disciplined in the second group and everybody being on the same page. I don’t think we’re always on the same page all the time … but at the end of the day I am prepared if (Brooks) does go that route.”

Bradley Beal on Scott Brooks, Nov 6, 2016. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Scott Brooks
item.description:
Mark Medina:Doc Rivers on Scott Brooks' firing:

“It’s a surprise. Right when you hear evaluating from a coaching standpoint, you know what that means.”

Doc Rivers on Scott Brooks, Apr 22, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Chris Paul, Russell Westbrook, Scott Brooks
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Doc Rivers on Scott Brooks saying Russell Westbrook is NBA's top PG:

“I didn’t know there was a ranking; do you get a trophy or anything? I love Chris Paul. I’d take him all day.”

Doc Rivers on Chris Paul, Russell Westbrook, Scott Brooks, Sep 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks
item.description:
Royce Young:Westbrook on if he's agrees with Scott Brooks about being the best PG:

“I do. I'm very honored to hear him say that. But that's how I feel.”

Russell Westbrook on Scott Brooks, Sep 29, 2014. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.
